2607.25576.title: Matrix-Free Photoacoustic Image Reconstruction via Sensor-Token Self-Attention
2607.25576.paper_summary: Photoacoustic tomography (PAT) combines the optical absorption contrast of biological tissue with the spatial resolution of ultrasound, yet recovering the initial pressure distribution from sparse-view sensor measurements remains an ill-posed inverse problem. Iterative compressive-sensing solvers and unrolled deep networks both retain a dependence on the system matrix at inference, which leaves real-time clinical reconstruction computationally expensive. This paper proposes the Sensor Attention Network (SAN), a Transformer-based architecture that treats the full time series of each sensor as a token and maps raw measurements directly to the reconstructed image without invoking the system matrix at inference. For training and benchmarking, an analytical k-space H-matrix is constructed and validated against the k-Wave pseudo-spectral solver under matched geometry, achieving a mean per-sensor Pearson correlation of 0.919 +/- 0.049, with k-space apodization and Gaussian temporal damping acting synergistically to reduce the energy-normalized mismatch by 49%. Trained with a vessel-weighted loss on 488 augmented samples and evaluated on 46 held-out samples against ISTA, split-Bregman total variation (SBTV), and learned ISTA (LISTA), SAN attains the highest mean SSIM (0.522) and PSNR (22.09 dB) and the lowest NMSE (0.233). Paired t-tests and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests confirm the superiority of SAN over LISTA on PSNR, NMSE, and Pearson correlation at p < 1e-8, and over ISTA and SBTV on all fidelity metrics. By bypassing the H-matrix at inference, SAN reduces reconstruction time by at least an order of magnitude, supporting real-time PAT reconstruction.
2607.25576.paper_summary_zh: 光聲斷層成像（PAT）將生物組織的光學吸收對比與超聲的空間分辨率相結合，但從稀疏視圖傳感器測量中恢復初始壓力分佈仍然是一個不適定的逆問題。迭代壓縮感知解算器和展開的深度網絡在推理時都依賴於系統矩陣，這使得實時臨床重建在計算上非常昂貴。本文提出了傳感器注意力網絡（SAN），這是一種基於Transformer的架構，將每個傳感器的完整時間序列視為一個標記，並將原始測量直接映射到重建圖像，而不在推理時調用系統矩陣。為了訓練和基準測試，構建了一個分析性的k空間H矩陣，並在匹配幾何下對k-Wave偽光譜解算器進行了驗證，達到每個傳感器的平均Pearson相關係數為0.919 +/- 0.049，k空間的窗函數和高斯時間衰減協同作用，將能量歸一化不匹配降低了49%。在488個增強樣本上以船隻加權損失進行訓練，並在46個保留樣本上與ISTA、分割Bregman總變差（SBTV）和學習ISTA（LISTA）進行評估，SAN達到了最高的平均結構相似性指數（SSIM）（0.522）和峰值信噪比（PSNR）（22.09 dB），以及最低的歸一化均方誤差（NMSE）（0.233）。配對t檢驗和Wilcoxon符號秩檢驗確認SAN在PSNR、NMSE和Pearson相關性上優於LISTA，p < 1e-8，並在所有保真度指標上優於ISTA和SBTV。通過在推理時繞過H矩陣，SAN將重建時間至少降低了一個數量級，支持實時PAT重建。
